TCP::enhanced_loss_recovery
Description
This iRule command will enable or disable TCP enhanced loss recovery,
which recovers from random packet loss more effectively.
Syntax
TCP
::
enhanced_loss_recovery
<
enable
|
disable
>
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
TCP
::
enhanced_loss_recovery
enable
}
